question_text: Was the Expedia data breach a hack?
answer_text: A vendor-side attack, yes: Expedia confirmed, per Skift, that attackers got in through a compromised third-party data platform provider. What was taken is not established.
label: Confirmed

question_text: Did hackers steal over a billion Expedia records?
answer_text: Unverified. A group called n0n claims about a billion records. Only about 500MB has been posted, and Expedia has not confirmed any figure.
label: Unverified

what_would_settle_it: Expedia saying what information was exposed, or a notice to customers or regulators.

question_text: Which vendor was compromised and how?
what_would_settle_it: Expedia or the vendor naming the vendor and publishing the cause.
